scope: Scientific plotting and source fidelity only; no simulation or scientific admission gates rerun.

visual_readback.method: Actual PNGs inspected through view_image after render; combined approximately 180 mm design width and separate approximately 90 mm designs.
visual_readback.single_column_solution: The linear benchmark uses separate trajectory/error axes; the angular panels use vertical facets at 3.54-inch width rather than shrinking the combined figure.
semantic_review: Original run01 labels and retained moment/accuracy failure circles are visible.
Both 27-case angular blocks are complete, with 8 coupled and 9 native infeasible supports in separate strips.
The coupled y=s/H* observable is distinguished in the caption from q=s/H and native A=DeltaP/U.
b0 is labeled a fixed-grid reference offset and never physical shear.
All off-panel native gate failures are explicitly preserved in provenance and caption.
The native 1e-6 line is identified as the preregistered large-b target, not an admission claim for every comparison point.
Near floating-point-level native b0=0 errors are shown without an invented convergence fit.

remaining_limitations: Visual QA is a bounded reviewer assessment, not a new scientific validation.
The original run01 failures remain even if separately published exact-moment reanalysis later changes observer classification.
No native coupled gravity or full EoR/production approval follows from these figures.
